name: silvershop-suite/store-locations
description: Physical store locations for SilverStripe CMS 6 (SilverShop suite): per-location address, contact and coordinates, regular and seasonal opening hours with exceptions (holidays, closures, special hours), open-now status, store list and detail pages and LocalBusiness JSON-LD. Works with or without SilverShop.

suggest.silvershop-suite/address-formats: Per-country address labels, required fields and formatting for the location address.
suggest.silvershop-suite/seo: Adds each location to the JSON-LD graph (Store / LocalBusiness with opening hours) instead of the module's own standalone JSON-LD.
suggest.silvershop-suite/cms-menu: Places the Locations admin in the grouped CMS menu.
suggest.silvershop-suite/storefront: Styles the store list, detail page, opening-hours table and status badge.
suggest.tractorcow/silverstripe-fluent: Translatable location names, texts and exception reasons.
suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-gridfieldextension: Drag-and-drop ordering of locations in the CMS.
